name: SpectrumLicenceRegister
tagline: Every spectrum licence, filing deadline, fee and coverage obligation in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete regulatory-affairs app for telecom operators: licence register, band plan chart of held frequencies with overlap detection, renewal filing and fee calendar, coverage obligation tracker and licence lifecycle (grant, renew, surrender, revoke) with regulator rules – for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Frequency band plan per band and area
Block renewal while fees are overdue
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (SpectrumLicenceRegister data-set + SpectrumLicenceRegisterPortal field control, shared src/app)
